description: Live prediction-market odds from Polymarket and Kalshi. Search markets and follow their price history, ask a question in plain English and get the odds, check a bookmaker's price for value, quote what an amount really buys once fees and order-book depth are counted, and see which venue is cheaper for the same outcome. Also VoxOdds' research signals, strategy backtests, research notes and an audited scoreboard of AI forecasts against the market. No account or API key required.
